method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two positively sloped parallel lines crossed by two negatively sloped parallel lines; ∠1 is at the upper-left crossing and ∠3 is at the lower-right crossing, and they occupy the same acute angle position formed by one line from each parallel family. From the text, take m∠1 = 53. Use the rule that corresponding angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, or equivalently that the angle between two parallel directions is preserved anywhere in the grid. Therefore m∠3 equals m∠1.
